description: Interactive-CO2 experiment with prescribed changes in tropospheric and stratospheric ozone concentrations only with other forcings held fixed at piControl levels, allowing carbon-cycle feedbacks.  For 1850-2021 use CMIP7 historical forcing datasets and for 2022-2035 use the Medium scenario.
branch_information: Initialize from an equilibrated pre-industrial control state from a simulation that included interactive-CO2 at a model-specified branch time.  Use independent initial conditions for ensemble members.
